Standalone PC & Console Action RPG • Original Mythic IP

FROZEN DHARMA
THE MYTHIC REAWAKENING

An ancient force has frozen portions of reality itself. Cross 15 handcrafted regions and 1,000 progression levels — from the Frozen Valley to the Final Mythic Realm — master six Dharma Resonance powers, and face 50+ cinematic bosses to reforge the balance of Dharma.

The Seal-Bearer wakes in Thawline Hamlet…

15 REGIONS • LEVELS 1–1000

1 · Frozen Valley (1–50)Abandoned villages, frozen falls, the Temple of the Still Flame.
2 · Sunken Kingdom (51–100)Flooded temples, dive ruins, the Drowned Library.
3 · Celestial Forest (101–200)Giant trees, floating isles, illusion gates.
4 · Ashen Empire (201–300)Lava rivers, siege forts, under-cities.
5 · Desert of Forgotten Gods (301–380)Buried colossi, mirage navigation.
6 · City of a Thousand Temples (381–460)Vertical holy metropolis, bell-puzzle network.
7 · Underground Kingdom (461–540)Crystal caverns, deep trade cities.
8 · Ocean of Eternity (541–620)Open sea, leviathan hunts, storm rites.
9 · Floating Celestial Kingdom (621–700)Sky islands, wind palaces, grapple lanes.
10 · Realm of Shadows (701–770)Dark mirror, light-and-shadow duality.
11 · Giant Mountain Sanctuary (771–830)Monastery peaks, trial ascents.
12 · Storm Kingdom (831–880)Eternal tempest citadels, storm riding.
13 · Ancient Battlefield (881–920)War-frozen time field, banner breaking.
14 · Frozen Heaven (921–970)Celestial ice palace, zero-friction duels.
15 · Final Mythic Realm (971–1000)Beyond reality: the Heart of Stillness.

TIMING COMBAT • DHARMA RESONANCE

  • Light / heavy / charged / aerial chains, executions
  • Dodge i-frames, perfect dodge, parry & riposte
  • Agni (fire) · Vayu (wind) · Varuna (water)
  • Prithvi (earth) · Akasha (cosmos) · Kala (time)
  • Fusion: Firestorm Vortex, Tempest Snare, Volcanic Strike
  • Stamina, poise breaks, weapon mastery, codex weaknesses
